items.description: Marvel Star Wars #2 (1977) CGC 9.8 White Pages, first comic appearance of Jabba the Hutt's original design. Historical Heritage lot #12409.
Marvel Star Wars #2 (1977) CGC 9.8 White Pages, Twin Cities pedigree copy (Gary Dahlberg Collection). Historical Heritage lot #11329.

Heritage multi-lot: complete Marvel Star Wars (1977) run #1-107 plus annuals, Return of the Jedi #1-4, and Marvel Movie Showcase #1-2, with every single book certified CGC 9.8 (most White Pages). Includes #2 and #6 but not sold/priced as standalone single-issue lots, and no individual cert numbers visible. Final sale result not confirmed via search.
